Blender and Molcy configuration

Molcy needs Blender to create video. Optional 405 MB download from Blender Foundation; it installs into your MolDesign data folder and we reserve 4.4 GiB. It does not ask for administrator permissions. It then runs offline; Molecular Nodes is installed separately.
